reasoning_quality_informational.v1_root_problem: Billing dispute ticket volume has roughly doubled since August 2026, from ~600/month (Jun–Jul) to 1180–1260/month (Aug–Sep) (E-02). The majority of disputed bills (1785 of 3025) are built on ACTUAL meter reads rather than ESTIMATED substitution (E-01) — a pattern inconsistent with a pure estimate-substitution cause and best explained by a change to billing import validation rules around August that introduced systematic bill errors across both actual-read and estimated bills (H-BILLING-RULE-CHANGE, SUPPORTED, uncontradicted). A tariff change (E-04, E-06) and slow/absent ticket response (E-03) are ruled out as alternative drivers.
